Subject: Request: secure sandbox credits + SOC2 excerpts for VPC POC

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo — the latency numbers look promising. We have one gating item before we can spin up the private VPC pilot: we need a short-term credit allocation to run an isolated sandbox and a couple of security artifacts to show internal auditors. Specifically: 

- 10k token credits or equivalent GPU hours scoped to an isolated VPC sandbox for 30 days
- A short excerpt of Redwood's SOC 2 controls relevant to data-in-transit and log retention (our auditors only need a few pages)
- High-level network diagram showing how the customer-managed VPC will front-end the inference cluster (for architecture review)

I attached our SOC2 requirement checklist and a rough timeline. Can Redwood provision credits conditionally while we finish procurement? Procurement also asked for a one-page credit approval form they can sign.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Best,
Alex
Director of Product
BlueHelix Health

- We can scope a 30-day isolated sandbox: recommended allocation is 12k token-equivalent credits (covers preliminary model tuning + integration tests).
- I can attach a 2-page SOC 2 excerpt focused on network controls and logging; this is the standard excerpt we share for POCs.
- I’ve cc'd our internal security contact (rishi) and finance lead (aditya) to expedite the approval form.

Next steps from our side:
1) Internal approval for provisional credit allocation (we'll need a signed credit-approval doc from your procurement).
2) We will provide the SOC 2 excerpt and a high-level network diagram (redacted to remove internal IPs).
3) Kick off sandbox provisioning once procurement returns the signed form and we receive confirmation of the BlueHelix project owner.

Would you like us to provision the sandbox under a temporary project name (e.g., BH-vpc-poc-2026) or use an existing account tag?

Chloe / Aditya —

Looks good to me. A few security notes to include in the conditional approval:

- The sandbox will be network-isolated; outbound egress will be limited to BlueHelix ACL'd destinations only.
- We require a signed attestation that BlueHelix will not ingest Redwood platform logs into any third-party analytics without prior approval.
- For audit purposes, please confirm: (a) the expected max sequence length and token throughput (helps sizing), and (b) whether they intend to run fine-tuning or inference-only.

If those items are documented and procurement returns the signed one-pager, I authorize provisioning. Finance should issue the provisional credit memo under deal BH-POC-2026-04.

Rishi
